title: Invalid session ID
reason: The session ID contains invalid characters. BIDS allows only the plus sign to be used as a separator in the subject entity label. Underscores, dashes, spaces, slashes, and other special characters (including #) are expressly forbidden.
solution: Rename the session without using any special characters except for `+`.
